evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet accounting logic and history RPCs in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp and src/wallet/receive.cpp.
rationale: Fixes long-standing issue #14136 where history RPCs fabricated per-recipient send entries and nonsensical negative fee calculations for mixed-input transactions like CoinJoins and Payjoins. Correcting misleading transaction history especially after rescans and descriptor imports provides substantial, durable reliability value for multi-party transaction users.
